Class LogfmtFormatterBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LogfmtFormatterBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
LogBuilder<LogfmtFormatterBuilder, LogFormatter>
public final class LogfmtFormatterBuilder extends Object implements LogBuilder<LogfmtFormatterBuilder, LogFormatter>
Builder to create LogFormatter. Formats events as logfmt, one line of key=value pairs per event like Go's log/slog text handler, selected with the logfmt encoder scheme.

Each event is written as one line, for example: time=2026-10-05T15:04:05.123Z level=INFO logger=com.example.App threadId=1 threadName=main message="hello world" requestId=42

  • The thread fields are chosen with ThreadFields, by default threadId and threadName.
  • time is the UTC instant with milliseconds.
  • level is written by the level formatter, by default TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, or ERROR. logfmt does not define level names, and tools differ (Go's slog is upper case, logrus lower case).
  • Every key value follows message, in order. A key value named like one of these fields is prefixed with keyValues..
  • A throwable adds error (its toString()) and stacktrace.
A value is quoted when it is empty or contains a space, =, ", or a control character. Inside quotes ", \, newline, carriage return, and tab are backslash escaped and other control characters are written as \uXXXX, so every event stays on one line. Characters logfmt does not allow in keys, and %, are percent-encoded (a b is a%20b), and an empty key is %, so different keys stay different.

Values can be colored like the TTLL formatter; keys, message, error, and stacktrace are not. Padding from a padding level formatter is written after the level's color.
